lead: Every mission sent to explore our solar system, from Sputnik in 1957 to today: where it went, which nation sent it, and what it did first.
try: Under All missions, press Firsts only. Then pick a nation, like India, from the All nations and agencies menu to see what it did first.
points: In 1959 Luna 2 became the first human-made object to reach the Moon, by crashing into it. Weeks later Luna 3 took the first pictures of the Moon's far side.
Mariner 4 was the first spacecraft to fly past Mars, and it took the first close-up picture of another planet.
India's Chandrayaan-3 made the first soft landing near the Moon's south pole.
